decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY replacing the piston-end arrangement with the new bushing retention method. Its control-piston rod motion path remains valid, and no additional candidate attribute must be changed or removed.
The new bushing movement and retention arrangement does not change any stated shaft dimension, stock specification, keyway rule, thread geometry, or bushing-space width.
The bushing arrangement does not alter the premachining, welding, or final-machining sequence, nor does it resolve the separate face-machining ambiguity.
Changing the bushing arrangement does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source changes bushing guidance and retention but does not change the specified CuSn12 bushing material or any other material rule.
The bushing arrangement is unrelated to the required 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.

The source supplies a design detail to incorporate, but it does not change the standing requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model; the detailed bushing state is owned by the source Requirement.
The instruction affects the bushing design represented in the drawings but does not change the independent obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The source does not establish or change any drawing dimension, annotation rule, or other state owned by this candidate Requirement.
